hero.title: Munich Biennale 2025
hero.subtitle: Festival of New Music Theatre
hero.description: Experience groundbreaking performances, opera, and contemporary arts from emerging and established artists across Munich's most prestigious venues.

season.description: This year's festival explores themes of transformation, identity, and renewal through innovative productions by emerging and established artists from around the world. Join us for six weeks of extraordinary performances that push the boundaries of contemporary opera and musical theater.

featured.title: Orpheus Reloaded
featured.excerpt: A contemporary reimagining of the Orpheus myth, blending electronic soundscapes with classical orchestration.

featured.title: Voices of Tomorrow
featured.excerpt: An immersive installation exploring the future of vocal performance through technology and space.

featured.title: The Passenger
featured.excerpt: Weinberg's powerful opera about memory, guilt, and reconciliation returns in a new production.

news.excerpt: Join emerging composers for a two-week intensive workshop led by festival artists.

about.title: About the Festival
about.description: The Munich Biennale is a leading platform for contemporary opera and musical theater, commissioning and presenting world premieres and innovative interpretations of existing works. Founded in 1988, the festival has become an essential destination for artists, audiences, and industry professionals seeking to experience the future of opera and performance.
